scenario: AITA for not wanting to share an animal crossing town with my girlfriend? | This is kind of petty but here goes. The new animal crossing game is coming out and you can only have one village per nintendo switch console. my girlfriend and I both have a switch, but she wants to share one village with me so were both using one switch to play.
